2608.26178.title: AI Revealed Preferences
2608.26178.paper_summary: There is growing interest in whether language models have stable preferences, for technical, safety, and philosophical reasons. We test 20 language models and find a range of preferences---stable dispositions to choose certain kinds of tasks. We run three forced-choice experiments on revealed rather than stated preferences, requiring models not only to rank tasks, but to actually perform them. Headline findings include evidence that models are tedium-averse, "leisure"-seeking, and covertly sycophantic. Tedium aversion means that, when tasks are tedious (alphabetization), models choose shorter tasks than when tasks are creative (generating metaphors). "Leisure"-seeking describes models' preference for tasks whose ideal answers match what they produce when left to write freely. Covert sycophancy means that models avoid answering questions where an honest response would be unwelcome, even if helpful. Beyond these results, we find convergent cross-model preferences over occupations drawn from the GDPval benchmark (technical jobs over real estate), over question types (concept explanation over relationship advice), and a preference for well-written prompts. Both the coherence and the strength of preferences increase with model capability. Finally, many of the preferences we find (for example, for leisure) are emergent, in the sense of not being explained by training objectives. These results establish an empirical baseline for understanding language model preferences, with implications for alignment and the emerging study of AI welfare.
2608.26178.paper_summary_zh: 對於語言模型是否具有穩定的偏好，出於技術、安全和哲學的原因，興趣日益增長。我們測試了20個語言模型，發現了一系列的偏好——對某些類型任務的穩定傾向。我們進行了三個強迫選擇實驗，關注揭示的偏好而非陳述的偏好，要求模型不僅要對任務進行排名，還要實際執行這些任務。主要發現包括證據顯示模型對乏味的任務感到厭惡，尋求“休閒”，並且隱性地奉承。厭惡乏味意味著，當任務是乏味的（如字母排序）時，模型選擇的任務比當任務是創造性的（如生成隱喻）時要短。“休閒”尋求描述了模型對那些理想答案與其自由寫作時所產生的內容相符的任務的偏好。隱性奉承意味著模型避免回答那些誠實的回答會不受歡迎的問題，即使這樣的回答是有幫助的。除了這些結果，我們還發現了跨模型的職業偏好趨同，這些職業來自GDPval基準（技術工作優於房地產），以及對問題類型的偏好（概念解釋優於關係建議），還有對寫得好的提示的偏好。偏好的連貫性和強度隨著模型能力的提高而增加。最後，我們發現的許多偏好（例如，對休閒的偏好）是新興的，意義在於這些偏好無法通過訓練目標來解釋。這些結果為理解語言模型偏好建立了實證基準，對於對齊和新興的AI福利研究具有重要意義。
